Crucially the check lives in the SHARED segment layer beneath BOTH interface faces: the single points+query face routes order_by through the same ScoringQuery::OrderBy -> scroll machinery, and remote_shard.rs:1161-1182 forwards order_by over gRPC to the same local check — the rejection is face-independent (batch vs single makes no difference), consistent with the sibling-log evidence.

This is a declared precondition enforced at read time and mapped to a descriptive 400 — not an accidental or unannotated behavior. The observed API response matches the source exactly; no gap between source and behavior exists.
